decisions.reason: Automatic removal of in-field text does not change the label text, label-to-initial-prompt relationship, or hover-help behavior.
The source changes placeholder clearing after activation, not the visual method used to identify fillable fields.
The source does not change or address preservation of Title-field formatting.
The robust placeholder mechanism remains required unchanged; automatic clearing is a separate interaction behavior already owned by the source Requirement.
The source does not replace or modify the checklist control type, and it does not establish application to this control at the source-event time.
The source does not replace or modify the dropdown control type or its Bestyrelsesmode scope.
Automatic placeholder clearing does not change the calendar-style date input method.
The source has no effect on required theme colors.
Placeholder clearing on field activation does not change automatic list continuation when Enter is pressed.
The source does not alter bullet appearance, scaling, alignment, or level-four styling.
The source concerns activation of control fields, not manual line-break entry after legacy-content pasting.
The source does not change style names, naming language, prefix, applicability, or covered style categories.
